query: SELECT id, event_type, quantity, to_char(occurred_at AT TIME ZONE $5, $6) AS occurred_at, metadata FROM usage_events WHERE tenant_id = $1 AND occurred_at >= $2::timestamptz AND occurred_at < $3::timestamptz ORDER BY usage_events.occurred_at DESC, usage_events.id DESC LIMIT $4
SELECT balance, updated_at FROM credit_balances WHERE tenant_id = $1
SELECT k.tenant_id, k.id FROM public.api_keys k WHERE k.key_hash = p_key_hash AND k.revoked_at IS NULL

INSERT INTO usage_events (tenant_id, occurred_at, event_type, quantity, metadata) VALUES ($1, COALESCE($2::timestamptz, now()), $3, $4, $5) RETURNING id, to_char(occurred_at AT TIME ZONE $6, $7) AS occurred_at

SELECT id, event_type, quantity, to_char(occurred_at AT TIME ZONE $7, $8) AS occurred_at, metadata FROM usage_events WHERE tenant_id = $1 AND occurred_at >= $2::timestamptz AND occurred_at < $3::timestamptz AND (occurred_at, id) < ($4::timestamptz, $5::uuid) ORDER BY usage_events.occurred_at DESC, usage_events.id DESC LIMIT $6
SELECT CASE WHEN v ~* $1 THEN v::uuid END FROM (SELECT current_setting($2, $3) AS v) s
